summary: Generates editable vertical, horizontal, radial, and circular color ramps whose keyframes can be stored in a DAT table.

key_params.name: dat
key_params.note: Table DAT containing ramp key positions and RGBA values.

key_params.name: color
key_params.note: Selected ramp key color and alpha.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Vertical, horizontal, radial, or circular ramp.

key_params.name: phase
key_params.note: Offset the start of the ramp.

key_params.name: period
key_params.note: Scale the ramp pattern in UV space.

key_params.name: extendleft
key_params.note: Behavior before the first ramp key.

key_params.name: extendright
key_params.note: Behavior after the last ramp key.

key_params.name: interp
key_params.note: Step, linear, ease, or Hermite interpolation between keys.

key_params.name: fitaspect
key_params.note: Fit radial/circular ramp to output aspect.

key_params.name: compoverinput
key_params.note: Composite generated ramp over the input.

key_params.name: multrgbbyalpha
key_params.note: Premultiply ramp RGB by alpha before compositing.

key_params.name: operand
key_params.note: Blend operation when compositing over input.

key_params.name: swaporder
key_params.note: Swap input/ramp order for output-page compositing.

common_gotchas: The ramp DAT stores key positions in 0-1 and RGBA values; malformed rows produce unexpected gradients.
Tension only applies when using Hermite interpolation.
Radial and circular ramps need center, aspect, and antialias settings tuned for clean output.
Dither helps reduce banding in smooth gradients, especially at low bit depth.
Extend Left Black uses the unusual official id blockclamptoblack while Extend Right Black uses black.
key_concepts: Generates editable vertical, horizontal, radial, and circular color ramps.
Ramp keys can be stored in a DAT table as position plus RGBA rows.
Radial and circular ramps use center, aspect-fit, and antialias controls.
Output-page controls can composite the generated ramp over the input TOP.
